sentences: Minimax optimization models a player minimizing an objective against a second player who maximizes it.
In nonconvex–nonconcave problems, stationary points need not represent the intended local minimax behavior.
The selected question asks for a first-order method whose stable convergence targets are restricted to local minimax optima.
Reversing the players' optimization order or merely driving both gradients toward zero can select inappropriate solutions.
A method with the desired guarantee would clarify the dynamics needed for adversarial optimization, including the mathematical problems underlying some generative-model training procedures.
